newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bertelsmann plans to expand core business.
newsitem.headline: Bertelsmann plans to expand core business.

text.p: German media giant Bertelsmann plans to expand in a bid to secure its core business areas, the group's chief executive told a German newspaper at the weekend.
Bertelsmann head Mark Woessner told Die Welt: "The Bertelsmann group is currently in very good but not in top shape."

The group's core business areas -- books, newspapers, magazines, and printers -- had performed better than expected despite sluggish economic conditions and increased competition from electronic media, Woessner said.
But innovations as well as an expansion into new markets were necessary to secure these traditional business areas.
Consequently the group's electronic media business was expected to be expanded, Woessner said, adding that Bertelsmann's third place in the global music business was also not enough.
